Yes folks, its May now. I don't want to post in the April thread anymore.


Here is my bog now:


Some sub arrangement:


Another Arrangement, because of the lack of space I had to open a new "distribution". Growths wins!


My darlingtonias left my greenhouse now. This is the first year where I would talk about a "stable population". I found the right cultivation for my location here finally:


Pinguicula grandiflora in full blooming:


Calopogon tuberosus:



Sarracenia oreophylla plus flower





Sarracenia leucophylla clone A from Thomas Carrow (different cameras, note what the camera can do! Don't be dissapointed if your Sarr colors do never fit to some photos in the web!)




Sarracenia leucophyll Helmuth's Delight (again different cameras and light)





Another leuco, but it got too few light... waiting for the autumn pitchers!




Rubra / flava hybrid ?



On of my top favourite rubricorpora, yuvenile from Thomas Carrow



Sarracenia flava in love!



... divorced!


My neps are shifted to my greenhouse now (because the Sarracenia are leaving):

Here a Nepenthes ventricosa: very large and white!



A promising flava seedling. Watch this long lid!



Flowers, flowers, flowers, ...










Rubra flowers:



leuco (left) rubra (right)



Stay tuned!


Sarracenia purpurea var. burkii
